crossRefs.note: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its…
but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be…
Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil…
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes…
Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break…
For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”

translations.web: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.
translations.bsb: The buds and branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
translations.kjv: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
translations.asv: Their knops and their branches were of one piece with it: the whole of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
